structural-causal.name: reliable power bottleneck control
structural-causal.basis: a diversified 55 GW platform can serve round-the-clock load with nuclear and dispatchable gas/geothermal resources, reducing dependence on a single generation technology

discovery-weak-signals.name: power-platform scale
discovery-weak-signals.basis: larger diversified generation fleet expands ability to serve data-center and industrial load growth

adversarial-red-team.name: integration leverage and regulatory-remedy risk
adversarial-red-team.basis: acquisition complexity and mandatory asset sales can dilute expected scale/synergy benefits

expectations-execution.name: integration execution
expectations-execution.basis: required divestiture advances regulatory commitments and monetizes assets, while reducing retained generation capacity

thesisQuality.basis: Large diversified generation/retail platform addresses durable firm-power demand, tempered by unproven post-close synergy capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: TTM revenue and net income remain substantial and positive, but Calpine leverage/integration and remedy execution reduce certainty.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: At $254.71 and 24.66 trailing P/E, valuation has plausible headroom after a pullback but is not independently demonstrated as compelling across scenarios.

catalystScore.basis: Calpine integration and regulatory-remedy completion are material identifiable catalysts, but realized timing/economics remain uncertain.

governancePower.basis: Management executed a large strategic acquisition and monetizing remedy assets, but current evidence is insufficient for exceptional long-duration stewardship claims.

alignment2036.basis: Nuclear plus dispatchable gas/geothermal capacity directly serves durable electrification, reliability and data-center power needs across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Combined generation technologies and competitive retail platform create multiple demand engines and cross-market reuse.

bottleneckControl.basis: Large firm-generation fleet participates directly in scarce reliable-power capacity; divestitures prevent a higher assessment.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Nuclear, gas and geothermal diversification improves resilience across power scenarios, offset by integration/regulatory exposure.

substitutionResilience.basis: Firm nuclear/dispatchable generation has meaningful replacement barriers for continuous load, while alternative generation/storage and transmission solutions remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Technology and regional generation diversity provide some redundancy, but current evidence does not establish exceptional fuel/equipment supply-chain redundancy.

pricingPower.basis: Scale and firm-power scarcity support value capture, but current cited evidence does not establish structurally protected pricing across cycles.

riskEvidence.basis: Material integration complexity, assumed Calpine debt, regulatory remedies/divestitures, gas/fuel exposure and successor transmission bottlenecks create meaningful but non-thesis-breaking risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Identity/tradability and transaction facts are primary-sourced and current market data is independently sourced; detailed realized post-close synergies, full balance-sheet integration and supplier concentration remain uncertain.

scoreRecord.thesis: CEG controls a large, diversified firm-power platform positioned for long-duration electricity demand growth, with nuclear scarcity and Calpine diversification creating durable strategic relevance if integration economics hold.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Calpine leverage/integration and regulatory remedies could erode expected scale economics while transmission constraints become the successor bottleneck.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Demonstrated post-Calpine operating results, synergy realization and deleveraging/remedy completion.

scoreBreakdown.note: Weighted arithmetic using Methodology 1.0.0 scoreWeights; risk and confidence are reported separately and not silently embedded into the component score.
